title: Remove all customer-facing 'Serving Ontario' service-area copy

requirements.summary: Remove all customer-facing storefront UI mentions of Ontario/service-area copy referencing Ontario.
acceptanceCriteria: No customer-facing text contains "Ontario" or the phrase "Serving Ontario" in the header, hero, footer, or other storefront pages.
A search across the frontend source for the string "Ontario" returns no remaining customer-facing copy (excluding non-user-facing/internal identifiers if any).

file_operations.description: Update the exported service-area string so it no longer contains "Ontario" or the phrase "Serving Ontario" (e.g., keep only the remaining region without adding new geography copy).

Remove "Ontario" from the company description paragraph and rewrite the sentence(s) to remain natural/accurate without introducing new regions; keep the "Contact Us" section phone-only per constraints.

requirements.summary: Adjust shared service-area copy and dependent UI rendering so punctuation/grammar reads naturally after Ontario removal.
acceptanceCriteria: Header subtitle renders cleanly without Ontario.
Storefront hero paragraph that interpolates the service-area copy reads naturally (no doubled periods, extra spaces, or trailing punctuation issues).
Footer company description no longer states it is serving Ontario and reads naturally in English.

file_operations.description: Refine the service-area constant wording (and any trailing punctuation) so it reads correctly in all usage sites (header subtitle and hero interpolation) after removing Ontario.
Review/update the hero paragraph that interpolates SERVICE_AREA_COPY to ensure clean English punctuation/spacing after the constant change (avoid doubled periods/trailing punctuation issues).
Verify/update the header subtitle rendering with the updated SERVICE_AREA_COPY so it displays cleanly (no awkward punctuation or spacing) after Ontario removal.
Ensure the updated footer company description reads naturally in English after removing Ontario, without adding any service-area/contact lines to the phone-only "Contact Us" section.
